decisions.reason: Having survived its first two years as a core-adjacent upholstery fabric with dedicated visibility, A likely meets at least modest aspiration levels, so we would keep it while continuing to monitor demand.
C fits the firm's established curtain business and its flame-retardant function is valuable in hospitality and project markets, making performance above aspiration and continued retention likely.

D remains somewhat more vulnerable because it has been less prominently featured, but its close fit with existing design and material capabilities and the firm's portfolio breadth support keeping it for now.

F is newer and therefore still somewhat uncertain, yet its own product page and strong adjacency to both upholstery and curtain lines make retention more likely than withdrawal while results accumulate.
